payload.name: FareHarbor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FareHarbor helps people easily discover and book tours and activities around the world. Our app connects travelers with trusted local operators, making it simple to explore experiences like sightseeing tours, outdoor adventures, cultural activities, and attractions in one place. With up-to-date availability, clear options, and a seamless booking experience, FareHarbor takes the friction out of planning memorable experiences, whether you’re traveling or booking locally.
payload.longDescription: FareHarbor 帮助用户轻松发现并预订全球各地的旅游和活动。我们的应用将旅客与可信的本地运营商连接起来，让你可以在一个地方轻松探索观光游、户外探险、文化活动和景点。凭借最新的可订情况、清晰的选项和流畅的预订体验，无论旅行途中还是在本地预订，FareHarbor 都能让难忘体验的规划更简单。

payload.name: Book Direct
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Book-Direct.co helps travelers find hotels and vacation rentals that accept direct bookings
No middlemen, no hidden fees.

Search by location or property name to get:
• Property cards with photos, ratings, and reviews
• Official website links for direct contact
• Phone and email details for property owners
• Messaging options for instant communication

We identify your travel details (guests, dates, location) and generate ready-to-send messages.

The workflow is streamlined so you can contact property owners directly with a conversational message no extra steps needed.

Perfect for travelers who prefer booking directly with property owners. 
Supports hotels, B&Bs, guesthouses, and vacation rentals worldwide.
payload.longDescription:
Book-Direct.co 帮助旅行者寻找接受直接预订的酒店和度假租赁住所
没有中间商，也没有隐藏费用。

按地点或房源名称搜索，获取：
• 包含照片、评分和评价的房源卡片
• 用于直接联系的官方网站链接
• 房源业主的电话和邮箱信息
• 即时沟通的消息选项

我们识别你的旅行信息（宾客人数、日期、地点），并生成可直接发送的消息。

流程经过精简，让你可直接用对话式消息联系房源业主，无需额外步骤。

适合希望直接向业主预订的旅行者。
支持全球酒店、住宿加早餐旅馆、客栈和度假租赁住所。

payload.name: Direct Host
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Direct Host helps travelers find official booking websites for vacation rentals, hotels, and unique stays—without middlemen. Instead of browsing multiple listing platforms, users can quickly discover direct booking links from property owners and managers, often with better prices, clearer policies, and more personalized service. It’s a simple way to book smarter, save on fees, and connect directly with hosts.
payload.longDescription: Direct Host 可帮助旅行者找到度假租赁、酒店和特色住宿的官方网站，无需中间商。用户无需浏览多个房源平台，即可快速找到由业主和管理方提供的直订链接，通常还能获得更优惠的价格、更清晰的政策和更个性化的服务。这是一种更明智的预订方式，可节省费用并直接联系房东。

payload.name: Is It Safe To Travel?
payload.description: 免费实时旅行安全评级
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get instant safety ratings for 200+ countries and major cities worldwide. Combines US State Department advisories, UK Foreign Office warnings, live conflict data (ACLED), and global news monitoring (GDELT) into one comprehensive safety score. Search any destination to see current threat levels, recent incidents, safety trends, and nearby city comparisons. All data updates in real-time from official government sources and verified news feeds—completely free with no limits.
payload.longDescription: 即时获取全球 200+ 个国家和主要城市的安全评级。它将美国国务院旅行警示、英国外交部警告、实时冲突数据（ACLED）和全球新闻监测（GDELT）整合为一项综合安全评分。搜索任意目的地，即可查看当前威胁等级、近期事件、安全趋势及附近城市对比。所有数据均来自官方政府来源和经过验证的新闻源，并实时更新——完全免费且不限次数。

payload.name: Busbud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The easiest way to travel by bus or train worldwide.

Busbud helps you book tickets for routes from thousands of bus and train companies, so you can quickly find and book the option that fits you best.

With Busbud on ChatGPT, you can:
• Explore schedules from thousands of bus and train companies
• Get up-to-date prices, amenities and availability
• Find the cheapest or fastest trips for your journey
• See key details at a glance: company profile, price, duration, and departure times

Why travelers choose Busbud:

• Coverage across 80+ countries and millions of routes, with strong presence in North America, Latin America, Europe, and Africa
• Trusted bus carriers like Greyhound, FlixBus, ADO, ALSA, BlaBlaCar, Trailways, Intercape, and many regional operators
• Train operators including VIA Rail, Amtrak, SNCF, Eurostar, and Renfe
• Clear, competitive pricing across bus and train carriers
payload.longDescription:
在全球轻松搭乘巴士或火车。

Busbud 帮助你预订来自数千家巴士和火车公司的线路车票，让你快速找到并预订最适合自己的出行方案。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Busbud，你可以：
• 查看数千家巴士和火车公司的时刻表
• 获取最新价格、设施和余票情况
• 为旅程寻找最便宜或最快的路线
• 一目了然地查看关键信息：公司简介、价格、时长和出发时间

旅客选择 Busbud 的原因：

• 覆盖 80 多个国家和数百万条线路，在北美、拉丁美洲、欧洲和非洲均有广泛业务
• 汇集 Greyhound、FlixBus、ADO、ALSA、BlaBlaCar、Trailways、Intercape 等值得信赖的巴士承运商及众多地区运营商
• 涵盖 VIA Rail、Amtrak、SNCF、Eurostar 和 Renfe 等铁路运营商
• 提供清晰且有竞争力的巴士和火车票价

payload.name: Travomint
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book cheap flights with Travomint and Get hassle-free flight booking , exclusive promo codes, verified reviews, and find the best flight deals.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Travomint 预订低价机票，享受轻松便捷的预订体验、专属促销代码和经核实的评价，并找到最优惠的航班。

payload.name: Atlys
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get verified visa requirements in seconds. Simply ask "Do I need a visa for Austria as an Indian citizen?" and Atlys App searches official government and embassy websites to deliver accurate, up-to-date answers. No more hunting through dozens of confusing portals or risking outdated information. Find out which visas you need, what documents are required, and get clear explanations, all verified from official sources. Whether you're planning a vacation, business trip, or relocation, get the visa information you need with confidence, right in your chat.
payload.longDescription: 几秒内获取经过核实的签证要求。只需询问“作为印度公民，我去奥地利需要签证吗？”，Atlys App 就会搜索政府和使馆官方网站，提供准确、最新的答案。无需再翻找数十个令人困惑的门户，也不用冒着使用过时信息的风险。了解需要哪些签证、要准备哪些文件，并获得清晰解释，所有内容均通过官方来源核实。无论你在规划度假、商务旅行还是搬迁，都能直接在聊天中放心获取所需签证信息。

payload.name: Pick your match
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
pickyourmatch finds travellers the exact bookable accommodation — not a room category. Every unit is individually described down to the view, the floor, the beds and the per-unit child and dog allowance, with data refreshed nightly from each property's GauVendi system.

Ask for "an apartment in Schladming for 2 adults, 2 kids and a dog, 16–19 August" and the app returns units that are actually available for those dates, with the real nightly rate and a direct booking link that opens the property's own booking calendar with the exact unit and dates preselected — no portals, no middleman, no fees on top.

Also included: themed promotions and packages (dog holidays, romance, wellness, culinary) with included extras, searchable by city or theme. The app is read-only, needs no account and processes no personal data.
payload.longDescription:
pickyourmatch 可为旅行者找到确切可预订的住宿单元，而非房型类别。每个单元都单独描述，包括景观、楼层、床铺，以及该单元允许入住的儿童和狗的数量；数据每晚从各房源的 GauVendi 系统刷新。

询问“帮我找 Schladming 的公寓，入住 八月 16–19 日，2 位成人、2 个孩子和 一只狗”，应用会返回这些日期确实有空的住宿单元，并提供实际每晚价格和直接预订链接。该链接会打开房源自己的预订日历，并预先选好确切单元和日期——无需门户网站或中间商，也不额外收费。

此外还提供主题促销和套餐（遛狗度假、浪漫之旅、康养、美食），包含套餐内的额外项目，可按城市或主题搜索。此应用为只读，无需账户，也不会处理个人数据。

payload.name: Jinko
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jinko helps you find the best flight and hotel deals for your next trip.

With Jinko, get recommendations based on your dates, budget, or any type of trip you’re planning. Explore all your options seamlessly within a single conversation. 

Try asking things like:

- Show me the best deals for a flight from New York in January. Less than 300$ per person, return trip.
- Recommend me a destination for Valentine's day for a 4-day trip. Direct flight only.
- Find me the cheapest flight from New York to Paris in February for a 7 days trip.

Book flights and hotels in the same conversation.
payload.longDescription:
Jinko 可帮助你为下一次旅行找到最优惠的航班和酒店。

使用 Jinko，根据日期、预算或任何类型的旅行计划获取推荐。你可以在同一段对话中轻松浏览所有选项。

可以尝试这样提问：

- 帮我找 一月从纽约出发的最佳航班优惠。每人低于 300$，往返。
- 为我推荐情人节期间 4 天旅行的目的地。只要直飞航班。
- 帮我找 二月从纽约飞巴黎、为期 7 天的最便宜航班。

在同一段对话中预订航班和酒店。

payload.name: Ferryhopper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ferryhopper helps travelers plan ferry journeys across Europe and the Mediterranean. Users can look up ferry ports, see which destinations are reachable directly from a port, search one-way, round-trip or island-hopping sailings of up to five legs with indicative prices and per-segment availability (cabins, vehicles, pets, e-tickets), inspect a specific sailing's vessel amenities, photos and accommodation options, and check disruption alerts such as strikes, weather warnings and cancellations. Search results link to ferryhopper.com, where the user completes the booking.
payload.longDescription: Ferryhopper 帮助旅客规划欧洲和地中海地区的渡轮行程。用户可以查询渡轮港口，了解从某港口可直达的目的地，并搜索单程、往返或最多五段的跳岛航程，查看参考价格和各航段的可用选项（客舱、车辆、宠物、电子票）。还可以查看特定航班的船上设施、照片和住宿选项，并查询罢工、天气警报和取消等运营中断通知。搜索结果会链接到 ferryhopper.com，用户可在那里完成预订。

payload.name: Sunny Cars Booking Assistant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find the right rental car through a simple conversation. Just describe your trip — destination, dates, and how long you need a car — and Sunny Cars finds matching offers with clear, all-in pricing and transparent insurance terms. Compare options and book with confidence, whether you're renting around the corner or across the world.
payload.longDescription: 通过简单对话找到合适的租车。描述你的行程——目的地、日期和用车时长——Sunny Cars 就会为你找到匹配方案，并清晰列出全部价格和透明的保险条款。比较选项后安心预订，无论你是在附近租车还是在世界各地租车。

payload.name: Chapka
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chapka Assurances helps you find the right travel insurance and get an instant quote. Answer a few questions about your trip, compare products, and receive your quote by email, all in one conversation.
payload.longDescription: Chapka Assurances 帮助你找到合适的旅行保险并即时获取报价。回答几个有关行程的问题，比较不同产品，并在同一段对话中通过电子邮件收到报价。

payload.name: A-Z London Transport
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
See a complete clear map of the London transport network when chatting.

Also includes current service status.
payload.longDescription:
聊天时查看完整、清晰的伦敦交通网络地图。

还包括当前运营状态。

payload.name: Shangri-La Circle
payload.description: 查找并预订香格里拉酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover our hotels and resorts directly in ChatGPT and get tailored stay recommendations through natural conversation. Share your destination, travel dates, and preferences, the app will suggest hotels that match your needs, whether you’re planning a romantic getaway, a family holiday, or a business trip.

Compare direct rates of our recommended hotels in an interactive carousel or map view, with short descriptions, photos, amenities, and key policies. When you’re ready, select Book Direct to continue on our website and complete your booking there.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中探索我们的酒店和度假村，并通过自然对话获取量身推荐。告诉应用你的目的地、旅行日期和偏好，它会推荐符合需求的酒店，无论你计划的是浪漫之旅、家庭假期还是商务出行。

在互动轮播或地图视图中比较推荐酒店的直订价格，查看简短介绍、照片、设施和重要政策。准备好后，选择“直接预订”，前往我们的网站并在那里完成预订。

payload.name: Nowistay
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nowistay helps vacation rental hosts manage daily operations in ChatGPT. Check bookings, availability, prices, guest records and messages, tasks, welcome guides, and private property knowledge for eligible Nowistay properties, then make approved updates without switching tools.
payload.longDescription: Nowistay 帮助度假屋房东在 ChatGPT 中管理日常运营。你可以查看符合条件的 Nowistay 房源的预订、可订状态、价格、住客记录和消息、任务、入住指南及私人房产知识，并在获批后进行更新，无需切换工具。

payload.name: RouteStack.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RouteStack helps people search and book travel in one place. Find hotels, flights, and rental cars with real-time availability, pricing, and booking options. Compare travel choices, explore destinations, review room and fare details, and continue to checkout when ready. Designed to make trip planning and booking faster and easier through a single travel experience.
payload.longDescription: RouteStack 帮助用户在一个地方搜索和预订旅行。查找酒店、航班和租车，并查看实时空房情况、价格和预订选项。比较旅行方案、探索目的地、查看客房和票价详情，并在准备好后继续结账。通过单一旅行体验，让行程规划和预订更快、更轻松。

payload.name: Novasol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
NOVASOL helps travelers discover holiday homes, holiday apartments, and vacation destinations across Europe. 

Search thousands of bookable holiday properties across 18 European countries, all within a conversation. 

Tell ChatGPT where you want to go, when, how many guests, your budget, and any must-have features, and it will surface a ranked carousel of matching homes with names, locations, prices, review scores, bedroom counts, and pet policies. Refine on the fly: change dates, shift your destination, tighten your budget, or add amenities and the results update instantly. Standout properties are highlighted so you can go straight to the card to see photos, full amenity lists, and booking options. This app covers self-catering holiday rental search only. It does not cover hotels, flights, car hire, package holidays, city apartments for short-term urban stays, aggregate price statistics, or any booking or payment action.
payload.longDescription:
NOVASOL 帮助旅行者发现欧洲各地的度假屋、度假公寓和度假目的地。

在一次对话中搜索覆盖 18 个欧洲国家的数千套可预订度假房源。

告诉 ChatGPT 目的地、日期、人数、预算和必需设施，它会以排序轮播展示匹配房源的名称、位置、价格、评分、卧室数量和宠物政策。可即时调整：更改日期、目的地、预算或设施，结果会立即更新。精选房源会突出显示，你可以直接打开卡片查看照片、完整设施列表和预订选项。此应用仅支持自助式度假租赁搜索，不支持酒店、航班、租车、套餐旅行、城市短租公寓、汇总价格统计，也不执行预订或付款。

payload.name: HelloSafe Travel Insurance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HelloSafe Travel Insurance Comparator helps you find and compare travel insurance plans from licensed providers, directly within your ChatGPT conversation.
Enter your destination, travel dates, and traveler details to receive personalized quotes with coverage information displayed side by side.
The app supports multiple countries, languages, and currencies, making it easy to compare options wherever you are traveling from.
Whether you need medical coverage, Schengen visa-compliant insurance, trip cancellation protection, or annual multi-trip plans, HelloSafe helps you quickly identify suitable options.
You can then continue on the HelloSafe website to view full details, refine your selection, and complete your purchase.
payload.longDescription:
HelloSafe Travel Insurance Comparator 可在 ChatGPT 对话中帮助你查找并比较持牌保险提供商的旅行保险计划。
输入目的地、旅行日期和旅客信息，即可获得个性化报价，并并排查看保障信息。
此应用支持多个国家、语言和货币，方便你从不同出发地比较选项。
无论你需要医疗保障、符合申根签证要求的保险、行程取消保障，还是年度多次旅行计划，HelloSafe 都能帮助你快速找到合适的选项。
之后可前往 HelloSafe 网站查看完整详情、调整选择并完成购买。

payload.name: Headout
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Headout helps you discover things to do when you travel.

Use natural language to explore tours, attractions, and activities across cities around the world. Search by destination, interest, traveler type, or specific landmarks to find experiences that match what you’re looking for.

With Headout, you can:
- Discover experiences in cities worldwide
- Explore activities linked to popular attractions and landmarks
- Find ideas for families, couples, solo travelers, and more
- Refine results through follow-up questions without restarting your search

This app focuses on discovery and planning. It helps you explore options, compare experiences, and decide what to do before booking.

Whether you have a specific place in mind or just want ideas, Headout makes it easy to explore what’s possible.
payload.longDescription:
Headout 帮助你发现旅行时可以体验的活动。

使用自然语言探索全球各城市的旅行团、景点和活动。按目的地、兴趣、旅行者类型或具体地标搜索，找到符合需求的体验。

使用 Headout，你可以：
- 发现全球各城市的体验项目
- 探索与热门景点和地标相关的活动
- 为家庭、情侣、独行旅客等寻找灵感
- 通过后续提问细化结果，无需重新开始搜索

此应用专注于发现和规划，帮助你探索选项、比较体验，并在预订前决定要做什么。

无论你已有明确目的地，还是只想寻找灵感，Headout 都能让你轻松探索各种可能。

payload.name: HappyFares
payload.description: 轻松预订 AI 航班
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HappyFares is India's AI-powered flight booking platform, now inside ChatGPT. Ask conversationally Cheap flights Delhi to Bangalore next weekend and get live fares in a rich card UI. Meera AI tells you whether prices will rise or fall, suggests cheaper nearby dates, surfaces alternate airports, and lets you set a price alert in one click. Group fares (7+ pax), refundable filter, and pre-filled booking links to happyfares.in for a seamless checkout. 40 lakh+ travellers trust HappyFares
payload.longDescription: HappyFares 是印度的 AI 航班预订平台，现已接入 ChatGPT。用对话方式询问“下周末德里飞班加罗尔的廉价航班”，即可在丰富的卡片界面中查看实时票价。Meera AI 会告知价格可能上涨还是下跌、推荐更便宜的邻近日程、展示备选机场，并让你一键设置价格提醒。支持团体票价（7+ 位乘客）、可退款筛选，以及预填好的 happyfares.in 预订链接，方便顺畅结账。超过 40 lakh 名旅客信赖 HappyFares。

payload.name: Paradise Beach Cozumel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your official digital concierge for Paradise Beach Cozumel. Easily manage or modify your reservations, explore day pass packages, check pricing, and get instant answers about amenities, add-ons, and everything you need for the ultimate beach day.
payload.longDescription: 这是 Paradise Beach Cozumel 的官方数字礼宾服务。轻松管理或修改预订，浏览一日通行套餐，查看价格，并即时了解设施、附加服务及享受完美海滩一日游所需的一切信息。

payload.name: Hotelzify - Book Direct
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hotelzify lets users search hotels, check live room availability and pricing for specific dates, and submit a hotel reservation request only after explicit confirmation of the room, dates, rate plan, guest details, and price. Search results and room options are shown as interactive widgets so users can browse properties, compare rate plans, and make an informed reservation request in one conversation. No payment is collected in the ChatGPT app.
payload.longDescription: Hotelzify 允许用户搜索酒店，查看指定日期的实时房型和价格，并且只有在明确确认房型、日期、价格方案、住客信息和价格后才提交预订请求。搜索结果和房型以互动组件展示，用户可浏览酒店、比较价格方案并在一次对话中做出知情的预订请求。ChatGPT 应用不收取款项。

payload.name: Virgin Atlantic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search Virgin Atlantic flights directly in ChatGPT. Explore routes, compare options, and find the flight that fits your plans, all in one conversation.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索 Virgin Atlantic 航班。在一段对话中探索航线、比较选项，并找到符合你计划的航班。

payload.name: FINN
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A FINN car subscription is a flexible way to stay mobile anytime - without long-term commitments like buying or leasing a car. With a fixed monthly rate that already includes insurance, maintenance, registration, and even CO₂ offsetting, the car subscription offers full transparency and convenience.

Best of all, you can book online in just a few minutes, and your new car will be delivered straight to your doorstep or you can pick it up at one of our stations.
payload.longDescription:
FINN 汽车订阅服务让你随时灵活出行，无需像买车或租赁那样长期承诺。固定月费已包含保险、保养、注册登记甚至 CO₂ 抵消服务，费用清晰透明，使用方便。

更方便的是，只需几分钟即可在线预订；新车会直接送到家门口，也可以到我们的任一站点自提。

payload.name: Direct Ferries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare and book from over 4k ferry crossings worldwide, using real-time pricing and availability, anytime, anywhere.

payload.name: FunNow

payload.name: Simbye

就在 ChatGPT 中，根据目的地获取个性化 eSIM 推荐。

payload.name: TrailVerse
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TrailVerse brings national parks exploration into ChatGPT.

Live data for 470+ U.S. national parks, monuments, and historic sites — plus day-by-day trip planning. Tell Trailie you’re a beginner with kids visiting Zion in July, and it can build a pace-matched itinerary using live NPS alerts and weather, with hike limits and family-friendly pacing when you ask. Always confirm safety-critical details on NPS.gov before you go.

Five focused capabilities:

• Plan a trip — Constraint-aware day-by-day itineraries (dates, hike difficulty/distance, pace). Revise the plan in the same chat. Best for NPS parks; also useful for broader U.S. trip ideas.

• Park details — Live weather, alerts, entrance fees, and top activities for NPS sites.

• Compare parks — Side-by-side 2–4 NPS parks with clear highlights.

• Search parks — Find NPS sites by state, activity, or name across the full catalog.

• Find events — Upcoming ranger programs, guided tours, and park-hosted events.

Read tools use the National Park Service API and live weather. Campground and permit inventory are not guaranteed live — confirm on Recreation.gov or NPS before booking. Free to use in ChatGPT. For saved trips, PDF export, and full Trailie history, continue at nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai.
payload.longDescription:
TrailVerse 将国家公园探索带入 ChatGPT。

提供美国 470 多个国家公园、纪念地和历史遗址的实时数据，并支持按天规划行程。告诉 Trailie 你是初学者、带孩子在 7 月游览 Zion，它便可结合实时 NPS 警报和天气，制定符合步行节奏的行程；按需考虑徒步限制和适合家庭的节奏。出行前请务必在 NPS.gov 确认涉及安全的重要信息。

五项专门功能：

• 规划旅行 — 制定考虑限制条件的逐日行程（日期、徒步难度/距离、节奏）。可在同一聊天中修改计划。最适合 NPS 公园，也适用于更广泛的美国旅行构想。

• 公园详情 — 查看 NPS 地点的实时天气、警报、入园费用和热门活动。

• 比较公园 — 并列比较 2–4 个 NPS 公园，并清楚展示亮点。

• 搜索公园 — 按州、活动或名称，从完整目录中查找 NPS 地点。

• 查找活动 — 查看即将举行的护林员项目、导览团和公园主办活动。

只读工具使用 National Park Service API 和实时天气信息。露营地和许可证库存不保证实时，请在预订前通过 Recreation.gov 或 NPS 核实。在 ChatGPT 中可免费使用。若要保存旅行、导出 PDF 并查看完整 Trailie 历史记录，请访问 nationalparksexplorerusa.com/plan-ai。

payload.name: BeachFinder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: BeachFinder helps you find and compare 184,900 swimming spots worldwide — beaches, lakes and bathing places. Search by city and rank spots for swimming, family, warm water, low wind, surf, snorkeling, whitewater or vanlife, then pull current weather, water temperature, wind, UV and wave planning signals for the top results. It also surfaces localized guides, source-backed activity providers and an anonymous aggregate of community reports. Every result links to getbeachfinder.com. All tools are read-only, and no tool ever declares a spot safe to swim — BeachFinder defers to official closures, flags, lifeguards and local authorities.
payload.longDescription: BeachFinder 帮助你查找和比较全球 184,900 个游泳地点——海滩、湖泊和浴场。按城市搜索，并根据游泳、家庭活动、温暖水域、低风速、冲浪、浮潜、激流活动或房车生活对地点排序，然后为排名靠前的结果获取当前天气、水温、风况、紫外线和波浪规划参考信号。它还提供本地化指南、有来源依据的活动服务商，以及匿名汇总的社区报告。每个结果都链接到 getbeachfinder.com。所有工具均为只读，任何工具都不会宣称某个地点可以安全游泳——BeachFinder 以官方封闭通知、旗帜、救生员和当地主管部门为准。

payload.name: OutReserve
payload.description: 查找露营地与房车营地

Your gateway to unforgettable outdoor experiences. Discover, book, and explore.

开启难忘户外体验之旅。发现、预订并探索。

payload.name: WeatherPromise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Protect your trip with WeatherPromise and get back the full cost if it rains more than promised during your vacation, automatically.
Tell us your destination, travel dates and trip cost and we'll show you an offer, personalized to your trip. Once you purchase the offer, your trip is protected.
You will get a link to your personal dashboard where you can monitor the weather during your trip. Rain is measured using independent, accurate data from official sources like NASA and NOAA.
If it rains more than the specified threshold, we'll email you automatically. Just confirm your details and the payment is sent right away, no additional proof required.
Go on your trip and if it rains more than promised, you get a full refund, automatically.
payload.longDescription:
使用 WeatherPromise 为旅程提供保障：如果假期降雨量超过承诺值，你将自动获得全额旅费返还。
告诉我们目的地、出行日期和行程费用，我们会提供一份为你的行程量身定制的报价。购买报价后，行程即获得保障。
你会收到个人仪表板链接，可在其中查看旅程期间的天气。降雨情况依据 NASA 和 NOAA 等官方来源的独立、准确数据测量。
如果降雨量超过规定阈值，我们会自动给你发送邮件。只需确认信息，款项就会立即支付，无需提供其他证明。
放心出行；如果降雨量超过承诺值，你将自动获得全额退款。

payload.name: Jumpseat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jumpseat helps users search for flights, add flights to their profile, update personal flight details, review upcoming trips, see friends' travel plans, and access live flight status resources through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Jumpseat 帮助用户搜索航班、将航班添加到个人资料、更新个人航班信息、查看即将出行的行程、查看朋友的旅行计划，并通过 ChatGPT 获取实时航班状态信息。

payload.name: Barceló Hotel Group
payload.description: 查找和探索 Barceló 酒店
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search and book 160+ hotels from Barceló Hotel Group across Spain, the Caribbean, Mexico, and more. Check real-time room availability and pricing, get detailed hotel information including amenities and policies, and generate direct booking links — all through natural conversation.

Covers Barceló Hotels & Resorts, Occidental Hotels & Resorts, Royal Hideaway, and Allegro brands. Supports multiple currencies and languages.

No payment is processed within ChatGPT — booking links open the official Barceló reservation system.
payload.longDescription:
搜索和预订 Barceló Hotel Group 在西班牙、加勒比地区、墨西哥等地的160+家酒店。通过自然对话查看实时客房可订情况及价格、获取包括设施和政策在内的详细酒店信息，并生成直接预订链接。

涵盖 Barceló Hotels & Resorts、Occidental Hotels & Resorts、Royal Hideaway 和 Allegro 品牌。支持多种货币和语言。

ChatGPT 内不处理付款——预订链接会打开官方 Barceló 预订系统。

payload.name: SparkSpot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SparkSpot — Easy Parking, Reserved Ahead

Find and reserve private parking spaces near your destination in just a few steps. Search available spots, book securely, and arrive knowing your place is waiting — no more driving around looking for parking.

Simple booking, secure payments, and stress-free parking — all in one place.
payload.longDescription:
SparkSpot — 轻松停车，提前预订

只需几步，即可在目的地附近查找并预订私人停车位。搜索可用车位、安全预订，到达时停车位已为你留好——无需再开车兜圈找车位。

预订简单、付款安全、停车无忧——尽在一处。

payload.name: Goshuin Atlas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search verified public records for Japanese temples, shrines, and goshuin designs. Compare nearby sacred places, build respectful visit shortlists, and clearly separate stable catalogue facts from details that should be rechecked before visiting.
payload.longDescription: 搜索经过核实的日本寺庙、神社和御朱印图案公开记录。比较附近的神圣场所，整理尊重当地习俗的探访候选清单，并清楚区分稳定的目录信息与出行前应再次核实的详情。

payload.name: TripO by FreeTravel
payload.description: 预订全球酒店并享受礼遇
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TripO lets you book hotels worldwide right inside ChatGPT — and unlike most booking sites, you don't give anything up to do it.
Add your loyalty membership when you book, and you keep what you've earned: points, elite status recognition, member benefits — all honored just as if you booked direct with IHG, Marriott, Hilton, and other major chains.
At select luxury and business hotels, TripO goes further. Our preferred rates come with extra benefits like complimentary breakfast, room upgrades when available, hotel credits, and early check-in or late check-out — perks normally reserved for high-end travel advisors.
Just describe what you need in plain language — "a hotel near Shinjuku Station next weekend, breakfast included, under $150 a night" — and TripO returns live availability and real rates from professional travel inventory. Compare room types, bed configurations, and cancellation policies, refine conversationally, and book without ever leaving the chat.
TripO is built by FreeTravel, a travel technology company connecting AI assistants with global hotel inventory.
payload.longDescription:
TripO 让你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中预订全球酒店，而且与大多数预订网站不同，你无需为此放弃任何权益。
预订时添加你的会员计划信息，即可保留已获得的权益：积分、精英会籍认可和会员福利——IHG、Marriott、Hilton 及其他主要连锁酒店都会像你直接预订一样认可这些权益。
在部分精选豪华酒店和商务酒店，TripO 还提供更多礼遇。我们的优选价格附带额外福利，例如免费早餐、视供应情况提供的客房升级、酒店消费额度，以及提前入住或延迟退房——这些礼遇通常只提供给高端旅行顾问的客户。
只需用日常语言描述需求，例如“下周末在新宿站附近找一家含早餐、每晚低于 $150 的酒店”，TripO 就会从专业旅行库存中返回实时空房情况和实际价格。比较房型、床型配置和取消政策，通过对话继续筛选，并且无需离开聊天即可预订。
TripO 由旅游科技公司 FreeTravel 开发，该公司致力于将 AI 助手与全球酒店库存连接起来。

payload.name: LDN Travel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LDN Travel makes getting around London simple and stress-free. Quickly view the current status of the Tube, Overground, Elizabeth Line, DLR, and Tram, see upcoming departures from any station and plan journeys between two stations with ease. Powered by TfL Open Data, the app provides accurate, official information so you can navigate London confidently. Perfect for commuters, tourists, or anyone exploring the city — all in one intuitive, easy-to-use app.

Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016' and Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019]
payload.longDescription:
LDN Travel 让伦敦出行变得简单省心。快速查看地铁、Overground、Elizabeth Line、DLR 和 Tram 的当前运行状态，查看任意车站的即将出发班次，并轻松规划两个车站之间的行程。该应用由 TfL Open Data 提供支持，提供准确的官方信息，帮助你自信地在伦敦出行。无论是通勤者、游客还是探索这座城市的人，都能在一个直观易用的应用中获取所需信息。

包含 OS 数据 © Crown copyright and database rights 2016' 和 Geomni UK Map data © and database rights [2019]

payload.name: Yatra
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Users can easily plan their travel by searching for flights and hotels using natural language. The app provides access to flight schedules, fares, hotel options, and travel information in one seamless conversational experience.
payload.longDescription: 用户可以通过自然语言搜索航班和酒店，轻松规划旅行。应用在流畅的对话体验中提供航班时刻表、票价、酒店选项和旅行信息。

payload.name: EF Ultimate Break
payload.description: 为 18–35 岁人群寻找团体旅行
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover group travel for anyone 18–35 to explore the world.  Tell ChatGPT where you want to go and find the best departure for you.
payload.longDescription: 探索适合所有 18–35 岁人群的团体旅行，畅游世界。告诉 ChatGPT 你想去哪里，它会帮你找到最适合的出发行程。

payload.name: Motel 6
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Motel 6 helps users search live hotel availability, compare property prices and amenities, inspect selected property details, open booking links and estimate travel time between a hotel and another location.
payload.longDescription: Motel 6 帮助用户搜索实时酒店空房情况、比较酒店价格和设施、查看选定酒店的详细信息、打开预订链接，并估算酒店与其他地点之间的行程时间。

payload.name: Stockholm Archipelago Trail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Stockholm Archipelago Trail app brings Sweden's 270 km island hiking trail into ChatGPT. Ask about any of the trail's ~20 island stages — from Arholma in the north to Landsort in the south — and get structured, up-to-date details: distance, difficulty, harbours and piers, and points of interest such as cafés, viewpoints, swimming spots, and shelters. The island stages are linked by public ferries, so you can plan routes that combine walking and boats.

Ask ChatGPT to show any stage on an interactive map, compare stages for a day trip or a multi-day hike, or pull practical details for the sections you're planning. All trail data is open (CC-BY-4.0) and read-only — the app stores no personal data. Place data comes from OpenStreetMap and Wikidata; the trail route is published by the Stockholm Archipelago Trail under CC-BY-4.0.
payload.longDescription:
Stockholm Archipelago Trail 应用将瑞典这条全长 270 km 的群岛徒步路线带入 ChatGPT。询问该路线约 20 个岛屿路段中的任何一段——从北部的 Arholma 到南部的 Landsort——即可获取结构化的最新详情：距离、难度、港口和码头，以及咖啡馆、观景点、游泳地点和避难所等兴趣点。岛屿路段之间有公共渡轮连接，因此你可以规划步行与乘船相结合的路线。

让 ChatGPT 在互动地图上显示任一路段、比较适合一日游或多日徒步的路段，或提取你计划行走路段的实用详情。所有步道数据均为开放数据（CC-BY-4.0）且只读——应用不存储个人数据。地点数据来自 OpenStreetMap 和 Wikidata；步道路线由 Stockholm Archipelago Trail 按 CC-BY-4.0 发布。

payload.name: BE-A
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BE-A enables to search for available hotels in your target area for real-time availability and prices. And you book directly with the hotel where you can leverage loyalty rates, discount for registered members and much more.

With direct connection to hotel's Availability and Rates systems, and in near future also to their Concierge and Booking systems, this is a very powerful all-round Hotel Booking Assistant.
payload.longDescription:
BE-A 让你搜索目标区域内有空房的酒店，获取实时可订情况和价格。你可以直接向酒店预订，享受忠诚会员价格、注册会员折扣以及更多优惠。

它直接连接酒店的房态和价格系统，并将在不久的将来连接礼宾和预订系统，是一个功能强大的全方位酒店预订助手。

payload.name: SoloWay — Bus Tickets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search live intercity bus trips across Ukraine and Europe. Get real-time prices, available seats, carriers, transfer details, and passenger discounts (children, students, seniors), and find the cheapest day to travel in a month. 
If no direct route exists, the app suggests verified alternatives via bigger cities nearby (with distances and prices).
Booking is completed on soloway.com.ua.
payload.longDescription:
搜索乌克兰和欧洲各地的城际巴士行程实时信息。获取实时价格、可用座位、承运商、中转详情和乘客折扣（儿童、学生、老年人），并找出一个月中出行最便宜的日期。
如果没有直达路线，应用会推荐经由附近较大城市的已核实替代路线（附距离和价格）。
预订需在 soloway.com.ua 完成。

payload.name: Airport Pickups London
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Book private car transfers to and from all London airports — Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton, and London City. Get instant fixed prices for Saloon, People Carrier, 8-Seater,   and Executive vehicles. All prices include meet and greet at the terminal, flight tracking, and free cancellation. Your driver waits at arrivals holding a name board. No        hidden fees, no surge pricing — the price you see is the price you pay. Available 24/7 for airport transfers, cruise port pickups, and any UK journey
payload.longDescription: 预订往返伦敦所有机场的专车接送——希思罗、盖特威克、斯坦斯特德、卢顿和伦敦城市机场。即时获取轿车、多人载客车、8座车和行政车型的固定价格。所有价格均包含航站楼迎接、航班跟踪和免费取消。司机会在到达区举着姓名牌等候。没有隐藏费用，也不动态加价——看到的价格就是实付价格。24/7提供机场接送、邮轮港接送和英国境内任意行程服务

payload.name: SecretBox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SecretBox helps users discover unique dining, hotel and spa experiences across France and Europe.
Ask for restaurant experiences, romantic hotel stays or wellness moments in a specific destination.
SecretBox provides curated experience suggestions and lets users explore them on the official SecretBox website.
payload.longDescription:
SecretBox 帮助用户发现法国和欧洲各地独特的餐饮、酒店和水疗体验。
按目的地询问餐饮体验、浪漫酒店住宿或健康养护体验。
SecretBox 会提供精选体验建议，并让用户在 SecretBox 官方网站上进一步浏览。

payload.name: Amapas Vacation Rental
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Amapas Vacation Rental helps you explore and reserve a 2-bedroom ocean-view condo in Puerto Vallarta's Zona Romántica, one block from Los Muertos Beach.

View the property details, check stay dates, see itemized pricing with taxes and fees, and submit a reservation request directly from the booking widget:

• Property details for the Amapas 353 condo
• Real-time pricing and availability
• Transparent price breakdown including taxes and cleaning fees
• Reservation request submission
• Email confirmation once your request is received

Located steps from Los Muertos beach above Mantamar and Almar Resort, Amapas 353 offers ocean views, rooftop infinity pool access, gym facilities, and easy access to the restaurants and nightlife of Zona Romántica.

Note: Payment is not collected inside ChatGPT. After your request is submitted, the property owner confirms availability and sends a secure payment link by email.
payload.longDescription:
Amapas Vacation Rental 帮助你探索并预订一套位于巴亚尔塔港 Zona Romántica 的 2 卧室海景公寓，距离 Los Muertos Beach 仅一个街区。

查看房产详情、查询入住日期、查看包含税费的明细价格，并直接通过预订组件提交预订申请：

• Amapas 353 公寓的房产详情
• 实时价格和可订情况
• 包含税费和清洁费的透明价格明细
• 提交预订申请
• 收到申请后通过 email 确认

Amapas 353 位于 Mantamar 和 Almar Resort 上方，距 Los Muertos beach 仅几步之遥，提供海景、屋顶无边泳池使用权和健身设施，还可轻松前往 Zona Romántica 的餐厅和夜生活场所。

注意：ChatGPT 内不收取付款。提交申请后，业主会确认可订情况，并通过 email 发送安全付款链接。

payload.name: Charge Atlas
payload.description: 在全球查找电动汽车充电桩
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Charge Atlas helps you find EV charging stations worldwide from inside ChatGPT. Search by place, coordinate, map viewport, or route, then filter by charger speed, connector type, vehicle compatibility, and charging network. Results open in an interactive map and include source coverage context from NREL and Open Charge Map.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Charge Atlas，查找全球电动汽车充电站。按地点、坐标、地图视口或路线搜索，然后按充电速度、连接器类型、车辆兼容性和充电网络筛选。结果将在交互式地图中打开，并附有来自 NREL 和 Open Charge Map 的来源覆盖范围信息。

payload.name: AutoRentals
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search real-time rental car deals across 100+ brands, compare rates and policies, and book on AutoRentals.com. Use it when you need a rental car anywhere in the US: describe your trip in plain language and get bookable options with transparent totals.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 100+ 个品牌的实时租车优惠，比较价格和政策，并在 AutoRentals.com 预订。当你需要在美国任何地方租车时，都可以使用它：用通俗语言描述行程，获得总价透明、可供预订的选项。

payload.name: TIRAVA - Taxi in Albania
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中预订出租车
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find fixed fares and estimated travel times for private transfers & Taxis in Albania. Simply submit a ride request. No online payment.
payload.longDescription: 查询阿尔巴尼亚私人接送和出租车的固定车费及预计行程时间。只需提交乘车请求。无需在线付款。

payload.name: Hotel Emperador Madrid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hotel Emperador Madrid Assistant helps guests find hotel information and complete common reservation tasks through chat.
Users can ask questions about Hotel Emperador Madrid, including rooms, amenities, hotel services, policies, and check-in/check-out times. The assistant can also check room availability and list optional room extras.
If a guest already has a reservation, the assistant can retrieve reservation details and help modify or cancel an existing booking when the required reservation information is provided.
The assistant can also help create a new booking and send support requests to the hotel if a guest needs assistance.
Example questions you can ask:
“What time is check-in at Hotel Emperador Madrid?”
“Do you have rooms available next weekend?”
“Show me available room types.”
“Modify my reservation dates.”
“Cancel my booking.”
“Contact the hotel for help with my reservation.”

Note: Some reservation actions may require providing booking details such as reservation code or guest information.
payload.longDescription:
Hotel Emperador Madrid Assistant 可帮助宾客通过聊天查找酒店信息并完成常见预订事务。
用户可以询问 Hotel Emperador Madrid 的客房、设施、酒店服务、政策以及入住和退房时间。助手还可以查询客房空房情况并列出可选房间附加服务。
如果宾客已有预订，提供所需预订信息后，助手可以检索预订详情，并帮助修改或取消现有预订。
宾客需要帮助时，助手也可协助创建新预订并向酒店发送支持请求。
你可以这样提问：
“Hotel Emperador Madrid 的入住时间是几点？”
“下周末有空房吗？”
“显示可订房型。”
“修改我的预订日期。”
“取消我的预订。”
“联系酒店，协助处理我的预订。”

注意：某些预订操作可能需要提供预订代码或宾客信息等预订详情。

payload.name: Eurostars Hotel Company
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan your next trip in minutes.

With the Eurostars Hotel Company app, you can discover hotels that suit you and book quickly and easily, without wasting time.

Choose a brand for every type of trip: Eurostars Hotels for city breaks, Áurea Hotels for boutique experiences, Dorma Hotels for leisure getaways, Exe Hotels for business trips, Ikonik Hotels for short city stays, Crisol Hotels for practical and affordable options, and Tandem Suites for apartments ideal for families or longer stays.

Just tell ChatGPT your destination, dates, and budget. Add your must-haves: area, breakfast, parking, spa, gym, or room type, and the app will recommend available hotels, refining the results with follow-up questions to get even closer to what you need.

Ask for what you want:
• “Romantic hotels in Seville with a spa for this weekend”
• “A centrally located hotel for 4 people in Valencia”
• “Availability tonight for under €150 in Barcelona”

Ready to travel? Click on the option you like best and complete your booking on the Eurostars website, without losing the thread.
payload.longDescription:
用 Eurostars

Hotel Company 规划旅行：可发现并快速预订合适酒店。旗下品牌包括

Eurostars Hotels、Áurea Hotels、Dorma Hotels、Exe Hotels、Ikonik Hotels、Crisol Hotels

和 Tandem Suites。告诉 ChatGPT 目的地、日期、预算及区域、早餐、停车、SPA、健身房或房型偏好，即可筛选；示例包括“本周末塞维利亚带

SPA 的浪漫酒店”“瓦伦西亚适合 4 人的市中心酒店”“巴塞罗那今晚 €150

以下的空房”。选定后在 Eurostars 官网完成预订。

payload.name: Skyalo Travel Guide
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Estimate mobile data needs, prepare devices, and build reliable connectivity fallbacks for any trip. Skyalo creates a provider-neutral travel data budget, setup checklist, offline-readiness plan, and backup guidance without comparing or selling connectivity products.
payload.longDescription: 估算移动数据需求、准备设备，并为任何旅程制定可靠的网络备用方案。Skyalo 会创建不受服务商影响的旅行流量预算、设置清单、离线准备计划和备用指引，不会比较或销售联网产品。

payload.name: CheapCaribbean Beach Finder
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan your next beach vacation with flexible package search across the Caribbean and Mexico. Compare destinations, travel dates, and prices in a single search to find the trip that fits your budget and schedule. Browse vacation packages that include both flights and hotels, explore the cheapest times to travel throughout the year, or narrow your search to specific dates. Whether you're deciding between Cancun, Punta Cana, Jamaica, or dozens of other beach destinations, you can compare your options side by side and find the vacay package that's right for you.
payload.longDescription: 通过灵活的套餐搜索，为下一次加勒比海或墨西哥海滩假期做计划。在一次搜索中比较目的地、旅行日期和价格，找到符合预算和日程的行程。浏览包含机票和酒店的度假套餐，查看一年中出行最便宜的时段，或将搜索范围缩小到特定日期。无论你是在 Cancun、Punta Cana、Jamaica 还是数十个其他海滩目的地之间犹豫，都可以并排比较选项，找到适合自己的度假套餐。

payload.name: Valpas Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search for hotels equipped with Valpas patented bed bug prevention technology.  Every hotel in our results is Valpas-certified, so you can travel with confidence knowing your accommodation prioritises hygiene, cleanliness, and guest safety.

What you can do:
  - Search for Valpas-protected hotels by city, neighbourhood, price, and style
  - Browse detailed hotel information including photos, amenities, ratings, and guest reviews
  - Get direct booking links to reserve your room

Whether you're planning a leisure trip, a business stay, or managing travel for a group, simply describe what you're looking for - "Find a boutique hotel in Paris with great reviews" or "Show me safe, clean hotels in Berlin near the city center" - and Valpas will recommend verified properties that match.

All results are limited to hotels using Valpas anti-bed-bug technology. If no protected hotels match your exact criteria, the app will let you know and suggest adjusting your filters.
payload.longDescription:
搜索配备 Valpas 专利臭虫防治技术的酒店。我们的所有搜索结果酒店均通过 Valpas 认证，让你可以安心旅行，相信住宿地点重视卫生、清洁和宾客安全。

你可以：
  - 按城市、街区、价格和风格搜索受 Valpas 保护的酒店
  - 浏览酒店详细信息，包括照片、设施、评分和住客评价
  - 获取直接预订链接以预订客房

无论你是在规划休闲旅行、商务住宿，还是为团体管理旅行，只需描述需求——“在巴黎找一家评价不错的精品酒店”或“给我看看柏林市中心附近安全、干净的酒店”——Valpas 就会推荐符合条件的已验证酒店。

所有结果仅限使用 Valpas 防臭虫技术的酒店。如果没有酒店符合你的全部条件，应用会告知你，并建议调整筛选条件。

payload.name: Campiri
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Campiri helps you find the right motorhome for your trip in ChatGPT. Just enter the dates, location, number of travelers, and your preferences, and the app will make it easier to navigate the available options. This way, you can quickly see which vehicle makes sense for your vacation, weekend getaway, or longer road trip.
payload.longDescription: Campiri 帮助你在 ChatGPT 中为旅程找到合适的房车。只需输入日期、地点、旅行人数和偏好，应用便会让你更轻松地浏览可选车辆。这样，你就能快速判断哪辆车适合度假、周末短途旅行或更长的公路之旅。

payload.name: ToursByLocals
payload.description: 预订当地导游的旅行团
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ToursByLocals is an excellent platform for connecting with local guides in numerous destinations worldwide. Users can search for private, guided tours by city or country and further refine their search by criteria such as group size or family-friendliness. By reviewing guide profiles, users can identify the ideal match for their trip. Once a suitable guide is found, availability on the user’s travel dates can be verified, and bookings can be made directly through their profile.
payload.longDescription: ToursByLocals 是连接用户与全球众多目的地当地导游的优质平台。用户可按城市或国家搜索私人导览行程，并进一步按团队人数或是否适合家庭等条件筛选。浏览导游资料后，用户可以为旅行找到合适人选；找到合适导游后，可核实其在旅行日期是否有空，并直接通过其个人资料页面预订。

payload.name: Life Happens Outdoors
payload.description: 查找带向导的探险行程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use ChatGPT to plan a real trip with Life Happens Outdoors. We run premium small group expeditions, Kilimanjaro, Everest Base Camp, Annapurna, the Dolomites, and more, with airport-to-airport support and LHO Team Leaders on every departure. Ask the app to find a trip for the dates and difficulty you have in mind, pull up a full itinerary with inclusions and what to expect at altitude, check which departures still have availability, and submit a consultation request directly to our team. You confirm every consultation inside the chat before it is sent, and you see our safety disclaimer about fitness, medical readiness, and final clearance before anything goes through. Built for explorers who want to do the thinking with ChatGPT and the trip with people who run expeditions for a living.
payload.longDescription: 使用 ChatGPT 通过 Life Happens Outdoors 规划真实旅行。我们运营高端小团探险，包括乞力马扎罗山、珠峰大本营、安纳普尔纳、多洛米蒂等线路，每次出发均提供机场到机场的支持，并由 LHO 团队领队全程陪同。你可以让应用根据日期和难度要求查找行程、查看包含项目和高海拔注意事项的完整路线、确认仍有名额的出发日期，并直接向我们的团队提交咨询请求。每项咨询都会先由你在聊天中确认，然后才会发送；发送前你还会看到有关体能、医疗准备情况和最终许可的安全免责声明。适合希望用 ChatGPT 做规划、与专业探险团队一起出行的探索者。

payload.name: Recorrido
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search for intercity bus tickets across Chile, compare schedules and prices from different bus companies, and choose the option that fits you best. Check seat availability and up-to-date fares to plan your trip without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: 搜索智利境内的城际巴士车票，比较不同巴士公司的时刻表和价格，并选择最适合你的选项。查看座位余量和最新票价，无需离开聊天即可规划行程。

payload.name: TravelSearch.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search
payload.longDescription:
Travelsearch 是一款结构化旅行搜索与发现工具，可根据自然语言查询返回高度相关的度假选项。

它利用丰富的多源产品数据，让 AI 智能体将用户意图（例如目的地、预算、日期、设施和旅行风格）与真实、可预订的旅行产品相匹配。

用户可以用日常语言描述行程，例如：

“London 有水疗和停车位的豪华酒店”
“Spain 低于 £2,000 的适合家庭的海滨度假村”
“含直飞航班的 Caribbean 全包式蜜月旅行”
系统会将用户意图映射到丰富的旅行属性和实时库存（价格、可订状态、地点、设施、评分和图片），生成结构化结果，其中包括：
住宿/度假产品名称、
描述、
匹配的设施、
明确说明各选项为何符合查询的理由，以及
来自可信旅行服务商的直接预订链接。
AI 智能体的主要能力：
将自然语言查询映射为数据集中的结构化旅行属性（目的地、时长、餐食方案、设施、价格范围、旅行者类型）
汇总多个品牌和供应商提供的酒店、套餐及度假村库存
返回按意图匹配程度排序的结果
提供可用于商业行动的结果（预订深层链接）

数据质量和覆盖范围：
多品牌、多供应商的产品数据源（不使用抓取内容）
根据供应商数据定期更新价格、可订状态等信息
对属性进行标准化和丰富处理，确保匹配一致

无需填写表单或使用筛选器，专为对话式搜索和 AI 旅行规划优化。

适用场景：
用户正在搜索假期、酒店或旅行建议时
查询包含偏好条件（预算、设施、旅行风格、同行人员类型）时
需要带链接的可预订选项时
结果需要按个性化条件定制，或按通用搜索之外的条件筛选时

payload.name: SnowSure
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SnowSure helps skiers and snowboarders find real-time powder, compare 14-day multi-model snow forecasts, and plan trips across 500+ ski resorts worldwide. Ask natural-language questions via the Answer Engine, browse ranked snow reports, inspect individual resort conditions, compare weather models, explore destination hubs like Niseko or Chamonix, and review season history and intelligence insights — all grounded in SnowSure's verified snow data.
payload.longDescription: SnowSure 帮助滑雪者和单板滑雪者获取实时粉雪信息、比较 14-day 多模型雪况预报，并规划前往全球 500+ 滑雪场的行程。通过 Answer Engine 用自然语言提问，浏览按排名整理的雪况报告，查看各滑雪场的具体状况，比较天气模型，探索 Niseko 或 Chamonix 等目的地中心，并查看雪季历史和智能分析；所有内容均基于 SnowSure 核实过的雪况数据。

payload.name: Simsurf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buying a travel eSIMs is a great way to stay connected to the internet and save money when travelling abroad. Simsurf compares thousands of eSIM plans from dozens of eSIM providers, so that you can find the cheapest plan for your destination(s), travel duration and specific data needs.
payload.longDescription: 旅行时购买 eSIM 是保持联网并节省海外通信费用的好方法。Simsurf 会比较数十家 eSIM 服务提供商的数千种套餐，帮助你根据目的地、旅行时长和具体流量需求找到最便宜的方案。

payload.name: TripHelm
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TripHelm turns trip planning into a real calendar instead of a tangle of notes, tabs, and screenshots. Describe your trip in plain language and TripHelm lays it out for you — flights, meals, check-ins, activities, and downtime, each placed on the right day at the right time.

Need to change something? Just say it: "push dinner to 8," "add a coffee stop before the museum," "lighten up day 3" — and the schedule updates. Everything saves to your TripHelm account and opens in the full web app, where you can drag, drop, and fine-tune any block by hand.

Plan a whole trip from scratch or adjust one already underway. Either way you walk away with a clear, hour-by-hour schedule you can actually follow — not a wall of text you're re-reading at the gate.
payload.longDescription:
TripHelm 将旅行规划整理成真正的日历，告别杂乱的笔记、标签页和截图。用日常语言描述行程，TripHelm 就会为你安排航班、用餐、入住、活动和休息时间，并放到正确日期和时段。

需要更改什么？直接说出来：“把晚餐推迟到 8 点”“在博物馆前加一站喝咖啡”“让第 3 天安排轻松些”——日程就会随之更新。所有内容都会保存到你的 TripHelm 账户，并在完整网页应用中打开，你可以手动拖动、放置和微调任何时间块。

从头规划整趟旅行，或调整已经开始的行程。无论哪种方式，你最终都会得到一份清晰、按小时排列且真正便于执行的日程，而不是一大段在登机口反复阅读的文字。

payload.name: Alpy.com
payload.description: 地球上最棒的滑雪装备租赁
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ski rentals across the Alps, made simple.

The Alpy.com ChatGPT app helps you find, compare, and rent ski and snowboard from shops across Europe—especially the Alps—without bouncing between tabs.

Try requests like:
	•	“Find ski rentals in Chamonix for Feb 10–15 for an intermediate skier.”
	•	“I need a kids helmet + boots package in Val Thorens, pickup 8:00 AM.”
	•	“Show me the best-value snowboard rental in Zermatt near the gondola.”

You’ll get relevant options with key details like equipment type, dates, pickup location, and price. Found the right fit? Tap through to Alpy.com to review details and complete your booking.
payload.longDescription:
让阿尔卑斯山各地的滑雪装备租赁变得简单。

Alpy.com ChatGPT 应用帮助你查找、比较并租用欧洲各地、尤其是阿尔卑斯山商店的双板和单板滑雪装备，无需在标签页之间来回切换。

试试这样提出需求：
	•	“为中级滑雪者寻找 Chamonix 在 2 月 10–15 日的滑雪装备租赁。”
	•	“我需要 Val Thorens 的儿童头盔 + 雪鞋套餐，8:00 AM 取货。”
	•	“给我看看 Zermatt 缆车附近最划算的单板滑雪装备租赁。”

你会获得相关选项，包含装备类型、日期、取货地点和价格等关键信息。找到合适的了？点击前往 Alpy.com 查看详情并完成预订。

payload.name: Hotel Moderno
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hotel Moderno helps guests ask about hotel policies, rooms, amenities, availability, optional extras, booking creation, reservation changes, cancellations, support requests, and conversation ratings through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Hotel Moderno 可通过 ChatGPT 帮助宾客咨询酒店政策、客房、设施、空房情况、可选附加服务、创建预订、修改预订、取消预订、提交支持请求以及为对话评分。

payload.name: Gullivr
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gullivr helps people plan shared trips in ChatGPT. Users can create trips, organize daily itineraries, add places, flights, accommodations, expenses, and packing items, then retrieve route distances and trip summaries from their private Gullivr workspace.
payload.longDescription: Gullivr 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中规划结伴旅行。用户可以创建行程、安排每日计划、添加地点、航班、住宿、支出和打包事项，然后从私人 Gullivr 工作区查看路线距离和旅行摘要。

payload.name: Tripbtoz
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tripbtoz is a hotel booking assistant that helps travelers find the right stay with less effort. Search hotels by city, district, or landmark, browse results in a clean list, and open any hotel to see key details—such as room options and rates for your dates—so you can compare quickly and decide with confidence. 

Why people will love it
- Find hotels by location or landmark in seconds
- Compare stays with a simple, readable results view
- Check room options and prices in one place before booking
payload.longDescription:
Tripbtoz 是酒店预订助手，帮助旅行者更轻松地找到合适住宿。按城市、地区或地标搜索酒店，以清晰的列表浏览结果，并打开任意酒店查看关键详情，例如你所选日期的房型和价格，方便你快速比较并放心决定。

人们会喜欢它的原因
- 几秒内按地点或地标查找酒店
- 通过简单易读的结果页面比较住宿
- 预订前在同一处查看房型和价格

payload.name: Pricewin Hotels & Flights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pricewin helps travelers search live hotel and flight prices, compare results from multiple travel sources, inspect hotel availability and cancellation terms, and follow links to complete booking outside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Pricewin 可帮助旅行者搜索实时酒店和航班价格，比较多个旅行来源的结果，查看酒店空房情况和取消条款，并通过链接在 ChatGPT 之外完成预订。

payload.name: Bytetravel
payload.description: 保险、eSIM、签证和 VIP 服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ByteTravel is a comprehensive travel ecosystem that centralizes essential services for the modern traveler through its specialized sub-brands. From instant global connectivity via Roamic eSIMs and seamless visa processing with Visagov, to exclusive airport lounge access through PrioVip and premium travel insurance by Globely, ByteTravel integrates everything into one premium interface. The platform acts as a discovery hub, allowing users to compare and access these specialized tools to ensure every journey is connected, protected, and comfortable.
payload.longDescription: ByteTravel 通过旗下专业子品牌，将现代旅行者所需的核心服务整合为完整的旅行生态系统。从 Roamic eSIM 提供的即时全球联网、Visagov 提供的便捷签证办理，到 PrioVip 的专属机场贵宾室服务和 Globely 的高端旅行保险，ByteTravel 将所有服务整合在一个优质界面中。该平台充当发现中心，让用户比较并使用这些专业工具，确保每次旅程都能保持联网、得到保障并舒适顺利。

payload.name: Ouigo France
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Préparez vos trajets facilement et voyagez à petit prix en Train Grande Vitesse ou Train Classique vers plus de 70 destinations en France et en Belgique, avec des billets à partir de 10 € selon votre gare de départ.

Accédez aux tarifs et horaires en temps réel en indiquant simplement votre gare de départ, votre destination et vos dates de voyage dans l’application OUIGO via ChatGPT. Comparez et affinez votre recherche pour choisir le train qui correspond à votre budget et à vos critères.
Une fois votre train sélectionné, vous n'aurez plus qu'à finaliser votre réservation en toute simplicité sur le site ou l’application OUIGO.

Personnalisez ensuite votre voyage selon vos besoins grâce aux différentes offres OUIGO :
  - OUIGO Essentiel : une formule à la carte, à compléter avec des options (choix de la place, bagage  supplémentaire ou volumineux, vélo plié ou sous housse, option OUIGOFLEX…)
  - OUIGO Plus : une formule « all inclusive » incluant le choix de la place, un bagage supplémentaire ou volumineux, ainsi que les services OUIFI et OUIFUN
 - OUIGO Full : une formule flexible, disponible à l’achat jusqu’à 7 jours avant le départ, incluant tous les avantages OUIGO Plus ainsi que l’option OUIGOFLEX pour échanger votre billet sans frais
payload.longDescription:
轻松规划行程，以实惠价格乘坐高速列车或普通列车，前往法国和比利时的 70 多个目的地；具体起价为 10 €，视出发车站而定。

只需在 ChatGPT 的 OUIGO 应用中输入出发车站、目的地和旅行日期，即可查看实时票价和时刻表。比较并细化搜索，选择符合预算和要求的列车。
选定列车后，只需在 OUIGO 网站或应用中轻松完成预订。

随后可根据需要通过不同的 OUIGO 票价选项定制旅程：
  - OUIGO Essentiel：按需搭配选项的基础方案（选座、额外或超大行李、折叠自行车或装袋自行车、OUIGOFLEX 选项……）
  - OUIGO Plus：“全包”方案，包含选座、额外或超大行李，以及 OUIFI 和 OUIFUN 服务
 - OUIGO Full：灵活方案，可在出发前最多 7 天购买，包含 OUIGO Plus 的所有权益以及 OUIGOFLEX 选项，可免费改签车票

payload.name: James Villas
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your ideal Mediterranean villa with James Villas in ChatGPT. Search handpicked, bookable villas across Croatia, Spain, France, Italy, Greece, Montenegro, Cyprus and Portugal using your preferred destination, travel dates, group size, budget and must-have features.

Whether you’re looking for a family villa with a pool, a pet-friendly coastal stay or a relaxing retreat with sea views, the app helps you quickly compare relevant options. Explore current pricing and availability, review key property details and open villa cards to see photos, amenities, locations and booking information, all without navigating endless search filters.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中通过 James Villas 找到理想的地中海别墅。根据目的地、旅行日期、同行人数、预算和必备设施，搜索克罗地亚、西班牙、法国、意大利、希腊、黑山、塞浦路斯和葡萄牙各地精选且可预订的别墅。

无论你想找带泳池的家庭别墅、允许携带宠物的海滨住宿，还是可以欣赏海景的休闲度假地，这款应用都能帮你快速比较相关选项。查看当前价格和空房情况，浏览房源要点，并打开别墅卡片查看照片、设施、位置和预订信息，无需在无穷无尽的筛选条件中翻找。

payload.name: PrivateJet.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Search private jet charters worldwide. Get instant pricing estimates across multiple aircraft categories, view detailed specs, and continue to our website to complete your booking.

Capabilities:
- Search flights between any two airports with real-time pricing
- Compare aircraft categories: Turboprops, Light Jets, Midsize Jets, Heavy Jets, Ultra Long Range, Airliners, etc
- View detailed aircraft specifications: capacity, range, cabin dimensions, baggage, etc
- Look up private jet airports by city, name, or ICAO/IATA code

Click Inquire in the results widget to continue your booking on privatejet.com.

payload.name: TiCATi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TiCATi is a curated luxury travel platform with direct hotel contracts and exclusive guest benefits. Search thousands of hotels worldwide, get live room availability and pricing instantly in your currency, and explore curated cruise voyages with exclusive onboard credits and VIP amenities.
Ask for a hotel by name and TiCATi returns live rates immediately, no sign-in required. A personal concierge is available via WhatsApp for bookings, upgrades, and special requests.
payload.longDescription:
TiCATi 是精选奢华旅行平台，与酒店直接签约，并提供专属宾客礼遇。搜索全球数千家酒店，即时获取以你的货币显示的实时客房余量和价格，并探索精选邮轮航程，享受专属船上消费额度和 VIP 服务。
按名称询问酒店，TiCATi 就会立即返回实时报价，无需登录。可通过 WhatsApp 联系私人礼宾，处理预订、升级和特殊需求。

payload.name: Dayuse Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and book hotel rooms available for a few hours during the day, not overnight. Search worldwide Dayuse inventory by city, budget, amenities, and time; view results on an interactive map; inspect hotel details; compare hotels; get answers to booking questions; and continue to dayuse.com to complete a reservation.
payload.longDescription: 搜索并预订白天可入住数小时（非过夜）的酒店客房。按城市、预算、设施和时段搜索 Dayuse 全球房源；在互动地图上查看结果、了解酒店详情、比较酒店、获取预订问题的解答，并前往 dayuse.com 完成预订。

payload.name: Momego
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan public transit journeys, get step-by-step walking and transit directions, find nearby stops, and check live departures and city coverage for over 600 cities around the world, including all major cities in the US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Korea and Japan.
payload.longDescription: 规划公共交通行程、获取逐步步行和公交指引、查找附近站点，并查看全球 600 多个城市的实时发车信息和服务覆盖范围，其中包括美国、加拿大、英国、欧洲、澳大利亚、新西兰、韩国和日本的所有主要城市。

payload.name: Kombo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kombo is Europe's multimodal travel comparison platform. Ask for a route and date, and Kombo compares train, bus and flight options across hundreds of European operators — SNCF Voyageurs, inOui, OUIGO, TER, Eurostar, Trenitalia, Italo, Frecciarossa, Renfe, Deutsche Bahn, SBB, SNCB, NS, Alsa, Flixbus, BlaBlaCar, easyJet, Air France, British Airways and more.

Choose a trip and continue to booking on kombo.co. Kombo supports all major discount cards and fares — SNCF Carte Avantage (Jeune, Adulte, Senior), Carte Liberté, MAX abonnements (MAX Jeune, MAX Actif, MAX Senior), Carte Famille Nombreuse, Grand Voyageur and Grand Voyageur Le Club, carte militaire, carte police nationale, Trenitalia CartaFreccia and Deutsche Bahn BahnCard — as well as SNCF group booking, and payment with SNCF digital gift cards, Chèques-Vacances and illicado.
payload.longDescription:
Kombo 是欧洲多式联运旅行比较平台。输入路线和日期后，Kombo 会比较数百家欧洲运营商的火车、巴士和航班选项，包括 SNCF Voyageurs、inOui、OUIGO、TER、Eurostar、Trenitalia、Italo、Frecciarossa、Renfe、Deutsche Bahn、SBB、SNCB、NS、Alsa、Flixbus、BlaBlaCar、easyJet、Air France、British Airways 等。

选择行程后可继续在 kombo.co 预订。Kombo 支持主要折扣卡和票价——SNCF Carte Avantage（Jeune、Adulte、Senior）、Carte Liberté、MAX 订阅（MAX Jeune、MAX Actif、MAX Senior）、Carte Famille Nombreuse、Grand Voyageur 和 Grand Voyageur Le Club、军人卡、法国国家警察卡、Trenitalia CartaFreccia 和 Deutsche Bahn BahnCard——以及 SNCF 团体预订，并支持使用 SNCF 数字礼品卡、Chèques-Vacances 和 illicado 付款。

payload.name: Kingston Hotels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The Kingston Hotels App lets you discover and book stays in Bangkok with exclusive direct-booking benefits. Enjoy complimentary breakfast, early check-in and late check-out privileges (subject to room availability), special offers, and seamless access to thoughtfully crafted hospitality experiences — all in one place.
payload.longDescription: Kingston Hotels 应用让你在曼谷探索并预订住宿，享受直接预订专属礼遇。体验免费早餐、提前入住和延迟退房（视客房空房情况而定）、特别优惠，以及便捷享受精心打造的待客体验——尽在一处。

payload.name: HomeToGo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover the world's largest collection of vacation rentals - millions of handpicked homes, hotels, villas, cabins, and hidden retreats, all in one place. From weekend getaways to month-long holidays, every stay is curated for unforgettable experiences. Whether you're seeking a boutique hideaway, an authentic local escape, or your next family home-away-from-home, find it instantly. Millions of stays. One seamless search. Infinite ways to travel.
payload.longDescription: 发现全球规模最大的度假出租房集合：数百万套精心挑选的房屋、酒店、别墅、小木屋和隐秘度假居所，尽在一处。从周末短途游到为期一个月的假期，每次住宿都经过精选，旨在带来难忘体验。无论你想找精品度假居所、地道的本地体验，还是下一处旅途中的家，都能即刻找到。数百万种住宿选择，一次顺畅搜索，无限旅行可能。

payload.name: Jettly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jettly helps you search and book private jet charters directly within ChatGPT. Compare available aircraft, review seating capacity and pricing, and find the best option for your trip.

Search one-way, round-trip, or multi-city private jet itineraries by providing your departure location, destination, travel dates, and passenger count. Jettly automatically resolves airport options and displays available aircraft in an interactive experience.

When you're ready to travel, select your preferred aircraft and continue to Jettly's secure booking flow to complete your reservation.
payload.longDescription:
Jettly 可帮助你直接在 ChatGPT 中搜索并预订私人飞机包机。比较可用机型、查看座位容量和价格，为行程找到最佳选择。

提供出发地、目的地、旅行日期和乘客人数，即可搜索单程、往返或多城市私人飞机行程。Jettly 会自动匹配机场选项，并以交互式体验展示可用机型。

准备出行时，选择心仪机型并继续进入 Jettly 的安全预订流程，完成预订。

payload.name: uhomes.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Find and compare student housing with uhomes.com. Search near a university, city, neighborhood, or transit stop; filter by budget, room type, commute time, and property brand; view photos, prices, ratings, facilities, and room options; then open uhomes.com when you are ready to continue booking.
payload.longDescription: 通过 uhomes.com 查找并比较学生住宿。按大学、城市、街区或交通站点附近的位置搜索；按预算、房型、通勤时间和物业品牌筛选；查看照片、价格、评分、设施和房间选项；准备继续预订时，再打开 uhomes.com。

payload.name: Mondial tourisme
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explorez une large sélection de voyages proposés par Mondial Tourisme vers des destinations incontournables : Turquie, Tunisie, Égypte, Grèce, Espagne, Maroc, Thaïlande, République Dominicaine ou encore la Laponie.
Affinez votre recherche selon vos dates de départ, votre ville et le type de voyage, puis consultez pour chaque hôtel les photos, les descriptions, les disponibilités et les tarifs actualisés afin de faire un choix éclairé.
payload.longDescription:
探索 Mondial Tourisme 提供的丰富旅行选择，前往土耳其、突尼斯、埃及、希腊、西班牙、摩洛哥、泰国、多米尼加共和国或拉普兰等热门目的地。
根据出发日期、出发城市和旅行类型筛选，然后查看每家酒店的照片、介绍、空房情况和最新价格，助你做出明智选择。

payload.name: BNESIM
payload.description: 查找、购买和管理旅行 eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BNESIM lets you find, buy, and manage travel eSIMs from ChatGPT.

Anyone can browse mobile-data plans by country or region and compare
cards by price, data amount, and duration. Tap a plan and Continue
to checkout on www.bnesim.com to complete the purchase — your card
details never leave BNESIM.

Signed-in BNESIM customers can also ask:
• How many eSIMs they have on their account
• How much data and wallet credit is left
• How to install a specific eSIM — QR code, one-tap iOS / Android
  install, or manual SM-DP+ setup

Payments and card entry always happen on www.bnesim.com, never
inside ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
BNESIM 让你在 ChatGPT 中查找、购买和管理旅行 eSIM。

任何人都可以按国家或地区浏览移动数据套餐，并按价格、流量和有效期比较卡片。点击套餐并继续前往 www.bnesim.com 结账完成购买，你的银行卡信息绝不会离开 BNESIM。

已登录的 BNESIM 客户还可以询问：
• 账号中有多少张 eSIM
• 剩余多少流量和钱包额度
• 如何安装特定 eSIM：二维码、iOS / Android 一键安装，或手动设置 SM-DP+

付款和银行卡信息输入始终在 www.bnesim.com 上进行，绝不在 ChatGPT 内进行。

payload.name: Tripuck
payload.description: 航班 + 集合地点——比较
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Tripuck is a flight meta-search and trip-planning service. This connector
lets you search live flight prices, explore a route's cheapest days of the
month, browse popular destinations from any origin city, and open full
segment / baggage details for any result — all without leaving the chat.

Tripuck's signature feature is **Meeting Point**: given 2-5 travelers flying
from different cities, it computes the cheapest and fairest common
destination, along with a per-person price breakdown and a fairness score.
It's ideal for coordinating trips where the group is spread across several
countries.

Every result deep-links back to tripuck.com for booking review and
checkout. The connector itself is read-only — it does not book, charge,
modify accounts, or hold any user payment information.

Supported user languages: Turkish, English, Arabic, Azerbaijani, German,
Georgian, and Uzbek. The tool infers the user's language from the
conversation and returns responses in that language, including right-to-
left layout for Arabic.
payload.longDescription:
Tripuck 是航班元搜索和旅行规划服务。此连接器
让你可以搜索实时机票价格、查看某条航线每月最便宜的日期、浏览从任意出发城市出发的热门目的地，并打开任一搜索结果的完整航段 / 行李详情——全部可在聊天中完成。

Tripuck 的特色功能是 **集合地点**：为从不同城市出发的 2-5 位旅客计算价格最低且最公平的共同目的地，并提供每人价格明细和公平性评分。非常适合为分散在多个国家/地区的团队协调旅行。

每条结果都会通过深层链接跳转到 tripuck.com，以便查看预订并结账。此连接器本身为只读：不会预订、收费、修改账户，也不会保留任何用户付款信息。

支持的用户语言：土耳其语、英语、阿拉伯语、阿塞拜疆语、德语、格鲁吉亚语和乌兹别克语。工具会根据对话推断用户使用的语言，并以该语言返回回复；阿拉伯语采用从右到左的版式。

payload.name: Buson
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The easiest way to travel by bus across Brazil

Buson helps you find and buy bus tickets for all of Brazil. Compare routes from the leading bus companies and choose the best option for your trip — quickly and simply.

With Buson on ChatGPT, you can:
• Explore schedules from hundreds of bus companies across Brazil
• Check real-time prices, seat availability, and onboard amenities
• Find the cheapest or fastest option for your trip
• View key details at a glance: bus company, price, duration, and departure times

Why travelers choose Buson:
• National coverage, connecting cities in every region of Brazil
• Trusted bus companies such as Cometa, 1001, Catarinense, Util, and many others
• Clear and competitive prices with no surprises
payload.longDescription:
在巴西乘坐巴士出行的最简单方式。

Buson 帮助你查找并购买巴西各地的巴士票。比较主要巴士公司的线路，快速、轻松地选择最适合行程的方案。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Buson，你可以：
• 查看巴西数百家巴士公司的时刻表
• 查询实时价格、座位情况和车上设施
• 查找行程中最便宜或最快的选项
• 一目了然地查看关键信息：巴士公司、价格、时长和出发时间

旅客选择 Buson 的原因：
• 覆盖巴西全国，连接各个地区的城市
• 汇集 Cometa、1001、Catarinense、Util 等值得信赖的巴士公司
• 价格清晰、有竞争力，没有意外费用

payload.name: IbiPoint — prepaid data eSIMs
payload.description: 覆盖 200+ 个国家和地区的 eSIM
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: IbiPoint helps travellers find and buy the right eSIM data plan for any trip across 200+ countries. Ask for a destination and get the best-value plans — Data Pack or Unlimited Flex — with prices, network details and an honest Transparency rating. Pick one, tap to buy on the IbiPoint shop, and the eSIM arrives by email. No app, no SIM swap, no surprise roaming bills.
payload.longDescription: IbiPoint 帮助旅客为前往 200 多个国家和地区的旅程寻找并购买合适的 eSIM 流量套餐。输入目的地即可获取性价比高的套餐——Data Pack 或 Unlimited Flex——并查看价格、网络详情和如实的透明度评级。选定套餐后，点击前往 IbiPoint 商店购买，eSIM 将通过电子邮件送达。无需安装应用、无需更换 SIM 卡，也不会产生意外漫游账单。
